payment_orphan.subject: Alert: orphan payment recorded — transaction :id
payment_orphan.intro: An **orphan payment** has been recorded on the platform. The payment was charged in Stripe but the linked resource was not found in the database when processing the webhook (it may have been deleted between the checkout start and payment confirmation).
payment_orphan.instruction: Action required: review the payment in the admin panel and determine whether a manual refund should be issued or the payment should be linked to another resource.
checkout.evaluation_invalid_status: This journal does not require an initial evaluation in its current status.
checkout.reevaluation_invalid_status: This journal cannot request a re-evaluation in its current status.
checkout.renewal_no_seal: This journal has never obtained the editorial seal and cannot renew it.
checkout.renewal_addons_hint: Add an Action Plan to improve your next editorial cycle.
evaluate.renewal_banner_title: 🔄 This is a RENEWAL of the editorial seal
evaluate.renewal_banner_policy: If this evaluation scores ≥75% with all critical indicators met, the seal will be extended automatically. Otherwise there is no refund: the editor paid for the evaluation, not for the seal.
renewal_evaluation.subject: New paid renewal pending evaluation
renewal_evaluation.intro: An editor paid for an Editorial Standards Seal renewal. The journal has re-entered the evaluation flow and requires a new editorial review.
renewal_evaluation.instruction: Start the re-evaluation when possible. If the final score is ≥75% and all critical indicators are met, the seal will be renewed automatically.
renewal_approved.subject: Your editorial seal has been successfully renewed
renewal_approved.intro: Your journal **":title"** passed the renewal re-evaluation. The Editorial Standards Seal has been extended.
renewal_approved.thanks: Thank you for upholding your editorial quality commitment.
renewal_rejected.subject: Your seal could not be renewed
renewal_rejected.intro: Your seal for **":title"** was not renewed because the evaluation did not reach the required 75%.
renewal_rejected.completed: The evaluation you paid for has been completed. Here are the details:
renewal_rejected.retry_offer: To retry, you can purchase a **re-evaluation** at a lower cost and work on the failed indicators before submitting again.
renewal_rejected.support: If you have questions about the failed indicators, please contact our team.
